findings.title: Inner main-thread CliJob startup is outside its cancellation cleanup region
locations: autorouter/gui.py:CliJob.run locked Popen startup before try/except BaseException
findings.precise_path: The outer cooperative CliJob sends SIGINT to the qualifier coordinator. The qualifier invokes each inner CliJob.run on its main thread with default SIGINT handling. That signal can raise KeyboardInterrupt during the locked Popen startup, before self.process assignment and before CliJob.run's cleanup try begins. A just-created CLI process may therefore continue while the qualifier catches KeyboardInterrupt, publishes a failed diagnostic and exits; the outer lane does not own that CLI's Native/engine groups. This is not the already-reviewed queued startup-safe signal shape.
